brand_identity.positioning: The Heart of Sport (Urheilun sydän) - Bringing sports to everyone through trust, accessibility, and K-Group security.

evidence: Strategic shift away from XXL-driven price wars
Focus on private labels (McKinley, Energetics) to improve margins
Leveraging K-Plussa data for customer understanding
Driving web traffic to brick-and-mortar (Click & Collect)
Global brand promise aiming for emotional connection

youtube.assessment: Passive storage for TV ads and outdated content; does not serve SEO or user needs.

tiktok.assessment: Focuses on tactical visibility and disconnected campaigns rather than continuous storytelling.

instagram.assessment: Tactical visibility and campaign-based influencer work.

linkedin.assessment: Not a primary focus in consumer diagnostic.

marketing_posture.audience_engagement: Pragmatic and transactional; audience views the brand as a place to buy goods, not as a community.

key_competitors.name: Stadium
key_competitors.content_strategy: Builds lifestyle and community with educational content (e.g., Ski School) and active YouTube presence.

key_competitors.name: XXL
key_competitors.content_strategy: Aggressive volume advertising, auctioneer style, outlet communication.

brand_losing_areas: Digital customer experience and content interest (vs. Stadium)

evidence: Slogan 'The Heart of Sport' vs. YouTube content consisting of TV ads
Excellent in-store service ('Lajimestarit') is hidden online
Lack of 'How-to' videos compared to competitors like Stadium
Serving the 'K-Plussa family' risks making the brand bland
Young people prefer Stadium; enthusiasts prefer specialty stores

opportunity_zones.rationale: Transforms silent in-store knowledge into dynamic video content (tips, Q&A, problem-solving) to meet customers where they search (Google/YouTube/TikTok).

opportunity_zones.description: Honest Finnish Sports Reality ('Localized Heart of Sport')
opportunity_zones.rationale: Owning the realities of Finnish exercise (slush, darkness) creates relatability and emotional connection, differentiating from global 'glossy' brands.
